title: Regulation of the Guarantee Fund (Fundo de Garantia)
text:
Regulation of the Guarantee Fund (Fundo de Garantia)
Entry into force on 1 March 2023.
With the entry into force of the new Regulation, BVLP and Interbolsa Regulation no. 1/2001, as amended by Regulation no. 1/2002, are revoked.
The documentation is only available in Portuguese
